You can easily invest in HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth in a hassle-free manner on Groww. The
process is extremely simple, quick and completely paperless. Invest in a few minutes with the following steps:

Log on to your Groww account

Search for HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth from the search box

In order to invest, you will have to complete all the KYC formalities which are completely online and paperless

Sector Allocation: 
Log on to your Groww account

Search for HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth from the search box

In order to invest, you will have to complete all the KYC formalities which are completely online and paperless
and take a few minutes to complete

Once you are done with that, you can start investing in HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth as SIP or lumpsum as per your
investment objective and risk tolerance

The HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth has been there from 28 Oct 2022 and the average annual returns provided by this fund is 31.04% since its inception.

The term Expense Ratio used for HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth or any other mutual fund is the annual
charges one needs to pay to the Mutual Fund company for managing your investments in that fund. The Expense Ratio of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is 0.18% as of 13 Nov 2026...

The AUM, short for Assets Under Management of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is ₹3,787.89Cr as of 13 Nov 2026.

If you want to sell your HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth holdings, go to your holding on the app or
web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your
desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox.

Sector Allocation: web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your
desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox.

You can select either SIP or Lumpsum investment of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth based on
your investment objective and risk tolerance.

The NAV of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is ₹29.59 as of 12 Nov 2026.

The PE ratio ratio of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is determined by dividing the market price by
its earnings per share and the PB ratio of the same is evaluated by dividing the stock price per share by its book value
per share (BVPS).
